name: Llorenç del Penedès (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and light blue with a narrow yellow stripe.
history: The official flag of Llorenç del Penedès is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green above and light blue below, with a yellow fess of thickness 1/6 of the height between the green and the blue; the colours represent the county, the blue the sea, the yellow the plain where the town lies and the green the mountains of El Montmell. The vexillological report of the Generalitat is dated 21 June 1997; the flag was approved unanimously by the municipal council on 4 September 1998 and published in the DOGC on 27 October 1998.
